question: What form of the supreme deity should the worshipper meditate upon?
premises: The deity is clothed in white garments.
The deity is three-eyed and supreme.
The worshipper meditates with joined palms.
inference: With joined palms, one should meditate on the supreme, three-eyed deity clothed in white.
plain_english: With joined palms, one should meditate on the supreme goddess, clothed in white garments and three-eyed.
